name: Chuuk Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Chuuk (western caroline islands)
description: A species of forest and forest edge habitats on Micronesia’s Chuuk Islands. Combination of bluish-gray head, pale orange throat and breast, brown-tinged wings, and slightly peaked head is unique on the islands.

name: Broad-billed Tody
rangeDescription: Arid scrub and woodland of hispaniola including gonâve island
description: A small, gemlike species of woodlands including coffee plantations and mangroves. The rather large head, long bill, and short tail create a profile shared only by the Narrow-billed Tody within its range.

name: Gray-breasted Parakeet
rangeDescription: Northeastern brazil (ceará)
description: Highly gregarious small parakeet with a long, pointed tail. Has a chestnut face, a dark cap, a grayish scalloped breast, and a large red patch on the belly.

name: Slate-colored Antbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to northeastern ecuador, eastern peru, and west-central amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized antbird. Males are gray with small white spots on the wings, and females are cinnamon with pale spots on the wings.

name: Australian Shelduck
rangeDescription: Patchy in southwestern and southeastern australia, including tasmania
description: Large rusty brown and black duck with extensive white in wings. Female has white around eye and bill, while male has an all-black head.

name: Obi Paradise-crow
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (obi and bisa)
description: A large, blackish, crow-like bird-of-paradise, endemic to Obi and Bisa. Body is entirely blackish with paler, browner wings.

name: Bare-headed Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Highlands of northeastern borneo
description: Thickset, dark-gray-brown laughingthrush with a bright-candy-red bill, broad blue moustache patches, and a sickly-looking bare yellow crown. Endemic to the highlands of north-central Borneo.

name: Pacific Flatbill
rangeDescription: Western colombia (chocó) to northwestern ecuador (south to southern pichincha)
description: Shy and inconspicuous flycatcher of lowland and foothill rainforest in western Colombia and northwestern Ecuador. Plumage is mostly olive with yellowish streaks on underparts, gray eyering, and brown patches in wings.

name: Sulphury Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela, trinidad, and the guianas to northern bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized flycatcher with a plumage pattern—brownish above, yellow below—that recalls Tropical Kingbird, but Sulphury Flycatcher is much darker gray on the face and head and has a contrasting white throat. Inhabits a variety of forest types but is most common in flooded and edge habitats with many palms—especially common in Moriche palm stands in savanna regions.

name: Preuss's Weaver
rangeDescription: Guinea and sierra leone to southern cameroon, gabon, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo
description: A yellow-and-black weaver with a distinctive golden-chestnut crown and a yellow back that extends to the upper tail. The forehead of the male is golden-chestnut, while that of the female is black.

name: Rufous-fronted Parakeet
rangeDescription: Central andes of western colombia (tolima and cauca)
description: Plump parakeet found only at very high elevations in Colombia’s central Andes, where it is quite scarce. Plumage is nearly all green; the tiny patches of orange on its face and chin are only evident when the bird is seen well.

name: Cinnamon Bittern
rangeDescription: India to southeastern asia, philippines, and indonesia
description: Small heron of wet and open grassy areas such as flooded meadows and paddy fields. Uniformly bright rufous upperparts of adult male unmistakable.

name: White-headed Duck
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed mediterranean basin to central asia
description: Remarkable odd-looking diving duck with a long tail, often held cocked. Males have a striking white face and black crown that contrasts with their large blue bill and chestnut body.

name: Visayan Shama
rangeDescription: Philippines (ticao, masbate, panay, and negros)
description: A medium-sized, long-tailed bird of lowland and foothill forest in the western Visayas. Black on the upperparts and tail, with a white belly and pale pink legs.

name: Harpy Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of central america to northeastern argentina and southern brazil
description: Massive bird of prey, restricted to mature forest and always rare. Enormous talons.

name: Blue-masked Leafbird
rangeDescription: Foothills of sumatra
description: The smallest and most unique-looking of the leafbirds. Stout-bodied, with a relatively long, faintly curved bill.

name: Mute Swan
rangeDescription: West-central to east-central palearctic region from central europe to southeastern china; introduced widely including to western and southwestern europe, japan, and eastern north america
description: Huge white bird with long neck, reddish-orange bill, and black face. Adults have a black knob on top of the bill.

name: Lesser Wagtail-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Along larger rivers of western and central amazonia from eastern ecuador (napo river) and eastern peru (río napo, río ucayali, and amazon river) eastward to central brazil (to the lower río tapajós); also a population (possibly an undescribed taxon) in río orinoco drainages in far eastern colombia (vichada) and southwestern venezuela (western amazonas)
description: Small, slender, and long-tailed bird found only on islands along major rivers in the Amazon basin. Distinctive in its specialized habitat with yellow underparts and eyebrow, and conspicuous white patches in its wings and tail.

name: Cuban Palm-Crow
rangeDescription: Western cuba
description: Endemic to Cuba. A large, all-black, gregarious species of open woodlands, scrub, and palm savannahs; often found in flocks of up to fifty birds.

name: Gray-capped Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (minas gerais and espírito santo to santa catarina)
description: Tiny flycatcher with a short bill and a long tail. It has an olive-brown back with a gray head and an “open” whitish face without a strong eyebrow.
